In overseas sales, orders for beauty products from existing customers were strong, and efforts are also being put into developing new customers in the home countries of foreign sales staff and elsewhere. entries.65626c9253b0321a: A business engaged in real estate and construction, and in supporting customers' land utilization and apartment rental management. Until the previous period this category was included in "Other Businesses," but because its quantitative importance increased, it became a reportable segment from the previous period (the fiscal year ended August 2024). For the fiscal year ended August 2025, net sales were ¥2,662 million (139.6% of the previous year) and operating profit was ¥16 million (an improvement of ¥284 million from the previous year). With its own design division and a specified construction business license, it built the warehouse and work building at the Chiba Factory and also receives contracted construction work such as apartment construction, custom-built homes and renovation work. In addition to strong purchases and sales of used detached houses and condominiums, it actively sold inventory properties in order to improve its financial position. It states that it will also focus on the Kentaku business going forward.

entries.7356b55afa078c64: This is the core business of the company group, engaged in the manufacture and sale of health foods and cosmetics and OEM supply (contract manufacturing for other companies' brands). Net sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended August 2025 were the largest of the six reportable segments; according to the MD&A, net sales were ¥18,903 million (104.4% of the previous fiscal year) and operating profit was ¥2,452 million (109.4% of the previous fiscal year). The securities report explains that the increase in net sales for the company as a whole was due to strong performance in this segment's overseas division. The business is described as divided broadly into an OEM division and an own-product sales division. In November 2024, aiming to expand sales in Islamic markets, halal certification was obtained for three products at the Chiba Factory.

entries.781e01712607283d: A retail business offering a wide variety of products, operating the department store "Saiya" (Yokosuka Store and Fujisawa Store) in Kanagawa Prefecture. Saiya is a company that files securities reports, and the company's share of its voting rights is 50.8%. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, net sales were ¥4,614 million (93.3% of the previous year) and operating profit was ¥61 million (185.0% of the previous year). New openings such as the fashion plaza "Pasios," the food supermarket "Life," "Pompadour" and the off-price shop "Locust" led to more store visits and higher rental income, and low-cost operations such as cost reductions accompanying the increase in rental space and a review of outsourced work were also continued, the securities report states.

entries.96d3926ce8a7b71b: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the company's group (the company and 23 consolidated subsidiaries) conducts its business in six [[term:segment|reportable segments]]. The core Healthcare Business consists of the manufacture and sale of health foods and cosmetics under its own brands, and OEM manufacturing and supply of products for other companies' brands, such as drugstore chains. The Pharmaceutical Business, which covers the manufacture and sale of Kampo prescription drugs and general medicines and the sale of generic drugs, is carried out by subsidiary Honsō Seiyaku. Other businesses include the Department Store Business, which operates a department store in Kanagawa Prefecture; the Food and Beverage Business, which runs restaurants; the Real Estate and Construction Business, which handles real estate sales and purchases, construction and land utilization support; and Other Businesses, which invests in new businesses such as tourism and charter bus services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥32,655 million (108.2% of the previous fiscal year), and the annual securities report attributes this to strong performance in the overseas division of the Healthcare Business.

entries.f81792c12201dc6a: A business that manufactures and sells Kampo (traditional Japanese herbal) prescription drugs and over-the-counter drugs and sells generic drugs, carried out by the subsidiary Honso Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, net sales were ¥2,471 million (107.0% of the previous year) and operating profit was ¥230 million (107.0% of the previous year). Orders for OEM (contract manufacturing for other companies' brands) of over-the-counter drugs increased, and sales were led by the in-house manufactured prescription generic drug "Pimuro Granules" (laxative), positioned as a priority product, and the generic lifestyle-improvement drugs "Sildenafil Tablets," "Finasteride Tablets" and "Tadalafil Tablets." Because the drug prices of prescription Kampo preparations rose in April 2024, a structure that can steadily produce a profit has been achieved, the securities report states.
